facts.fact: Vespergate Works appointed Arun Kelso as chief executive effective January 12, 2026
facts.name: APPOINTED

facts.fact: VGW offered customers a dedicated telephone service.
facts.name: OFFERED

facts.fact: VGW suspended shipments from the affected assembly line pending inspection.
facts.name: SUSPENDED_SHIPMENTS

facts.fact: VGW suspended export deliveries through the weekend.
facts.name: SUSPENDED

facts.fact: VGW established a safety committee to examine the supplier records.
facts.name: ESTABLISHED

facts.fact: VGW offered customers replacement parts.
facts.name: OFFERED

facts.fact: The transcript of the public webcast is retained by the publisher.
facts.name: RETAINED
